Ganesh idol immersions cause chaos and litter in Visakhapatnam

Ganesh idol immersions in Visakhapatnam following Vinayaka Chavithi celebrations resulted in chaos and left beaches littered with idol remnants and waste. The Deccan Herald reported that authorities urged adherence to safety norms during the immersion process.
